job.title: Scheduling Officer

job.title: Recruitment Coordinator
job.description:
Are you an experienced Recruitment Administrator/Coordinator eager to develop your career in a purpose driven organisation?

What’s in it for you? 
  • Work for a community-focused not for profit making a real impact across Victoria
  • One month temporary role with opportunity for extension 
  • Work-life flexibility with 4 days WFH, 1 day in the office (Wednesdays)
  • Avoid the CBD - Footscray head office with free car parking available
  • Mentorship and continuous learning opportunities available
  • Supportive and inclusive culture
  • WHV holders welcome to apply!

The Company

Join a progressive, forward thinking community organisation committed to increased allied health outcomes across the state. This is a workplace that genuinely values balance, flexibility, and professional growth, while maintaining a strong focus on delivering positive and impactful services to the community.
  
The Role 

Reporting to the Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will be responsible for providing administrative and operational support across a broad range of HR and recruitment matters.

Additionally, you will:
  • Process employee documentation including contracts, onboarding, position descriptions, and database maintenance
  • Respond to and resolve HR Helpdesk tickets within agreed timeframes.
  • Assist hiring managers with end to end recruitment and staff coordination - phone screening, shortlisting, compliance and reference checks
  • Coordinate job advertising across multiple recruitment platforms and ensure posting accuracy.
  • Maintain the administration and maintenance of recruitment records, employee documentation and associated approval processes.
  • Complete regular reporting to support industrial agreement implementation
  • Build strong relationships with hiring managers to identify workforce needs and provide advice on hiring strategies and compliance requirements 
  • Contribute to continuous improvement across HR quality, workforce operations and compliance frameworks
  
What will I need to succeed?
  • Proven experience in a Internal Recruitment Coordinator role or HR Administrator role
  • Strong understanding of employment legislation and Award/Agreement interpretation
  • Proven experience with systems including Dayforce (desirable)
  • WWCC and Police Check required for the role 
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion
  • A positive, proactive self-starter with a “can do” attitude

job.title: Recruitment Specialist - 360 with no sales!
job.description:
360 recruiter but don't love the new business developement?
Eager to build fulfilling partnerships with a vast array of organisations?
Then look no further…. 
  • Opportunity to work in an 360 Recruitment role without the pressures of sales and individual targets - hot desk, team based role
  • Generalist and varied role - dual desk, work on array of positions across different industries!
  • Full time, permanent role
  • CBD location with WFH flexibility - 2 days per week after training 
  • Work in a fun, dynamic culture
  • Morning teas, lunches, fruit platters and company events & activities
  • Fast paced environment with lots of fun and laughs along the way
  • Attractive hourly rate on offer plus incentives
  • Boutique agency - plenty of learning opportunities, and one on one training and support
  
About Us
Hugo Personnel is an Australian owned and managed, corporate recruitment agency. We recruit across all industries in areas of customer service, administration, marketing, human resources and finance on a temporary, contract and permanent basis.

Our office is located right in the heart of the CBD, very close to public transport with work from home flexibility after the probation period.
  
The Role
Supporting our Recruitment Manager, you will work closely with a small team to manage a large portfolio of clients across permanent and temporary recruitment. 

Your main responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  • Collect recruitment briefs from the Recruitment Manager and clients
  • Resource a high quality of candidates across an array of permanent and temporary positions 
  • Submit and discuss shortlisted candidates with clients
  • Write job adverts, conduct phone, MS Teams and face to face interviews
  • Coordinate interviews, references and background checks
  • Visit the offices of new and existing clients with the Recruitment Manager
  • Negotiate and influence salary expectations and offers to candidates
  • Assist with filling short term temporary roles 
  • Optimise alternative recruitment strategies eg. Headhunt through Seek, LinkedIn and our referral program
  • Assist with the on-boarding process, ensuring a smooth transition
  • Administer the recruitment system (JobAdder)
  • Provide recruitment support to the wider recruitment team
  
What you need to succeed? 
  • Proven experience in recruitment/agency/internal/HR experience – but it’s really going to be your personality, energy and drive that sets you apart!
  • Qualifications in HR/Business/Marketing or a related field will be highly regarded, but definitely not essential
  • Experience managing end-to-end recruitment – desirable, but not essential
  • Ability to be agile, organised and juggle multiple priorities without dropping the ball
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills – you genuinely enjoy connecting with people
  • Someone who takes ownership, is accountable for their work and is honest and upfront – even when things don’t go to plan
Come join our close knit and energetic team who work hard but also have a lot of fun and laughs along the way.

Interviews will be held immediately! Good luck!

 This is a trusted and autonomous EA role supporting the CPO and CFO, with responsibility for keeping complex priorities, stakeholders and key business activities moving seamlessly. job.title: Payroll Specialist
job.description:

A exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Payroll Officer to join a highly regarded, values driven not-for-profit organisation delivering services across disability, aged care and retirement living. Their stunning offices are close to public transport, with retail shops, restaurants and public transport at walking distance. Our client fosters a collaborative and inclusive culture, empowering their people while investing in capability and continuous improvement. They are committed to maintaining high standards of care and service delivery, with a strong focus on quality, integrity and teamwork.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to liaise with a variety of stakeholders
  • Advanced Ms Excel and systems savvy

  • Adaptable, positive and has a desire to grow!

  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work under pressure

If you’re an experienced HRBP who is hands-on, loves ER and can jump in and make an immediate impact, we would love to hear from you.

Please apply with a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role.
Interviews will be held immediately.
Good luck!
